messages:
Alex (sales): NovumBank asked for our compliance pack to advance the PO — need SOC2 Type II, ISO27001 cert if available, signed pen-test letter, KMS/HSM attestation, and an on-prem statement. Can we assemble and commit ETA?
Devon (solutions): I have the SOC2 package and diagrams. Need to confirm scope = production only? @Tom
Tom (acct exec): Confirmed: production scope only. Also they asked whether Redwood Private incurs extra pricing — answer: yes, its a separate line item. I can estimate uplift but need node counts.
Alex (sales): Good. Checklist (copying so were aligned): SOC2 Type II (prod), ISO27001 cert, signed pen-test letter (vendor attestation vs our internal attestation?), KMS/HSM integration diagram, data flow/PII diagram, audit log retention policy, on-prem/air-gap packaging note, contact for artifact delivery.
Mouna (security): Ill draft the pen-test letter template and the KMS attestation. Note: vendor-signed pen-test attestation typically 3-5 business days after we request it. If they want a new test scoped to their infra, thats a separate paid engagement.
Ellen (legal): I have an NDA audit addendum we can attach. If they want raw logs, we require a Data Processing Addendum update and scoping call.
Tom (acct exec): Pricing note: VPC/on-prem adds a one-time deployment fee + higher monthly platform fee — estimate ~20-30% uplift on committed capacity, depends on GPU sku and region.
Devon (solutions): Drive link internal: https://drive.internal/redwood/compliance/NovumBank-1801 (contains SOC2 package, ISO scan, network diagram). Missing signed pen-test letter and updated KMS diagram for their region.
Mouna (security): Requesting pen-test vendor now. @sec-bot create ticket.
sec-bot: Ticket created #SEC-4520  pen-test vendor attestation request for NovumBank. ETA 72 hours.
Alex (sales): Customer wants a short cover note summarizing bundle contents, known gaps, timelines (pen-test 3-5bd, on-prem 2-3 wks), and pricing callouts. They need it by EOD tomorrow to share with procurement. Ill draft.
Devon (solutions): Ill upload revised KMS diagram and README in ~1 hour. Need confirmation: prod log retention default?
Mouna (security): Prod retention default 90 days, 1 year archival on request (longer requires Private or paid add-on). Ill add a short policy snippet.
Ellen (legal): Uploaded NDA addendum and signature instructions to the drive.
Tom (acct exec): Prioritize this one  target quarter close. Ill follow up on pricing once Devon confirms nodes.
Alex (sales): Drafting cover note now. Will highlight vendor attestation timeline and optional paid re-test if they want custom scope. Posting draft here in ~2 hours. :thumbsup:
Mouna (security): Vendor updated #SEC-4520 with estimated delivery 72 hours. Flagged the re-test caveat.
Alex (sales): Thanks all. Will attach cover note + Ellens addendum and send to Novum when complete.
